# Single owner-directed deferred limitations tracker

**Status: deferred, not implemented/qualified.** The owner clarified that all known limitations handed off when closing #265, #266, #270, #271 and #273 belong in **one** issue with the `deferred` label. The provisional #277–#282 were closed as superseded, **not completed**; their bodies/comments preserve the initial split for audit. Closing the original issues means a scoped branch handoff, **not** that any draft PR was merged, a release gate passed, or a speed comparison is qualified. The [committed #273 ledger](https://github.com/Ephemeral-AI-Lab/layerfs/blob/9e906331a/core/docs/issues/273/CHECKPOINT5-OPTIMIZATION-LOG.md) retains experiments and all historical FAIL/INELIGIBLE rows. Gitignored `benchmark-results/fs-bench-pro/issue273/checkpoint5-optimization/iter-012`–`iter-019` are **local** evidence, not GitHub raw URLs.

## 1. SDK same-Workspace pinned journal: owner decision required (former #276)

The public `WorkspaceApi` exports mount/exec/commit/status/unmount but no live same-Workspace G1 journal pin/lease/release spanning the registered clean and one-edit sequential SDK Exec/Commit controls; both currently emit `NOT_RUN`. A detached Store, closed fixture or Workspace-only Stage is not a substitute. **Owner choose one:** prospectively approve a public SDK/Bridge lease specifying selected identity, G1 old-reader bytes, continuing G2 process/edit admission, max 32 captures, charged ownership/refund, cancellation, deadlines and known/unknown canonical custody, with independent byte/pin/failure oracles; **or** explicitly rule/waive these two controls for a named profile while retaining `NOT_RUN` and not calling the 12-row registry complete. No approval or waiver has been recorded. See [decision request](https://github.com/Ephemeral-AI-Lab/layerfs/blob/9e906331a/core/docs/issues/273/OWNER-RULINGS-SDK-CACHE-CONTROL.md).

## 2. Matched frozen control and private cache/phase-cgroup evidence (former #277)

An owned, clean detached checkout pins frozen #271 product `48b51e874a41b3e1e6c6661e145316df8b408f07` (tree `64d06dabba1a6d123d1002487c189809ded05cc0`) but has **no control samples**. Nine candidate rows pass independent bytes; **all remain numerically INELIGIBLE**. Host source mincore PASS and Linux O_DIRECT request do not prove private container metadata/VM/backend/device/host cache equivalence. An owned Docker cgroup-v2 probe released a 32 MiB shmem file and wrote `0` to writable `memory.peak`; readback still reported **36,163,584** while `memory.current` was **2,428,928**. A lifetime peak cannot be called a phase peak. **Gate:** supply identical verifiable private cache and Exec/Commit-local cgroup conditions for both arms, port only genuinely common observer/harness changes without editing frozen product, then prospectively run all 12 control→candidate rows row-major once per changed identity; or record an owner ruling that numeric comparison remains ineligible on this profile. No censored 25-second control wall as a denominator. See [iter-018](https://github.com/Ephemeral-AI-Lab/layerfs/blob/9e906331a/core/docs/issues/273/CHECKPOINT5-OPTIMIZATION-LOG.md#iteration-018--explicit-c1-zero-provenance-frozen-control-arranged-numeric-admission-blocked).

## 3. Normalization pages and package-scale C5 limits (former #278/#279)

At the unchanged default 8 MiB Budget the nonregistered 8,192-WRITE functional diagnostic passes full bytes/Commit/clean-close; a distinct 10,240-WRITE control after a known remote Commit locally refuses C5 `Capacity` and retains custody, then ACKs a new G2 WRITE. A **physical** backing allocation fault instead stops writes with `Busy`. None of this proves arbitrarily many edits, multi-file package installs/updates/deletes, clean-close refund after a *retained failed* attempt, or constant RAM. The public dispersed no-key-normalization page versions 0/0/810/3,154 at 100/512/4,097/8,192 first appear at WRITE 2,659 and are at most one per affected WRITE; no parent is proved removable. One unqualified instrumented Stage loop saw a raw 8,192/4,197 quotient ~2.076 for ~1.952x WRITEs, with unknown private cache and observer overhead—**not a qualified speed law**. **Acceptance:** preregister realistic multi-file package/namespace/payload/rename workloads; prove full selected G1/live G2/32-pin bytes, repeated no-pin Commit quota continuity, actual `st_blocks*512` plus checked reservations, charged peak, cancellation/known-failure custody and exact refund under fixed limits. Only consider dropping a normalized ancestor after authenticated fence/child target/slot epoch/old-pin and failure/refund equivalence, otherwise keep it. If a true changed-frontier cannot fit, explicitly refuse and seek an owner profile ruling or specify bounded charged streaming before raising the limit. Related parent scopes #245, #248 and #256 are not automatically closed by this issue.

## 4. Deferred *unimplemented* #270 pure directory-move C1 Commit (former #280)

#270's seven original acceptance checkboxes were **not** completed; owner requested #270 closure and transfer here, not relabelling them PASS. Keep [#270](https://github.com/Ephemeral-AI-Lab/layerfs/issues/270) and its [Phase 4.5 source-pinned spec](https://github.com/Ephemeral-AI-Lab/layerfs/blob/6eb7553671d3000160ad023a57b335e52dd81a26/core/docs/issues/245/PHASE4_5_C1_COMMIT_FOLLOWUP.md) normative. **Acceptance:** checked compatible versioned/authenticated owner index or smaller equivalent, v1/legacy old-reader and migration/History identity proof, unique-parent and acyclic *final-batch* validation including duplicate/replacement/removal, path-local `O((K+D)h)` target work/new `O(Kh)` index pages, actual page visit/file-save counters, independently verified old/new moved subtree bytes, negative cycle/alias rejection, pins, charged quota and failure custody. Draft PR #269/#264 mounted rename alone does not supply this C1 Commit result.

## 5. Broad test red and integration (former #281/#282)

The new-source **broad** locked-release Core host run FAILED two `layerfs-content/tests/filesystem_ordering.rs` cases: `a_fresh_build_charges_its_count_array_to_the_ordering_ceiling` and `a_high_pending_ceiling_runs_spill_free_to_the_byte_bound` (`ObjectLimitExceeded { limit: 18, actual: 19 }`). Targeted C1 edit/Server/Workspace/FUSE and all-target Clippy/fmt pass, but no aggregate-test or release green claim is allowed. A paired parent all-tests run is NOT_RUN; do not call the red proven pre-existing. Have the owning filesystem ordering lane diagnose and repair/test without inflating a ceiling for a benchmark. The #273 candidate's explicit #248 C1 edit-load zero is proved at the changed source, while historical missing-zero receipts remain unchanged.

Draft **unmerged** PR #262 (#265/#266), #272 (#271), #274 (#273, source through `9e906331a`) and namespace dependency #269 require owner review of merge order, combined-source format/legacy/old-pin and canonical identity, locked tests, byte/charge/failure oracles and all gate outcomes **before** integration or release. Keep PR #274 draft: issue closure is not merge approval. Match frozen control only after §2; no 2x/10x, universal quadratic/constant-RAM, package-install, CI-green or release claim follows from branch-only results.

## Exit decision

Owner explicitly rules §1 and §2 (approved capability plus proof, or named waiver/ineligible status), owning lane resolves §5 test red, #270 acceptance receives independent source-bound proof or is ruled permanently out of scope, and §3's workload/representation claims are bounded and byte-/custody-verified. Record source/parent/LOC and raw manifest identities for every new attempt; never repeat an unchanged performance arm or rewrite historical receipts. No close/merge/release claim merely because this umbrella issue exists.

The current implementation’s disk-backed active state is followed by Commit paths that materialize dirty-inode vectors, per-file extent vectors, accumulated deletion-key lists, a whole reconciliation patch and ordered/index scratch in memory. The admitted-memory peak therefore grows with dirty-file count and surviving extent/namespace fragmentation. A single-file 10,240-write failure is a meaningful warning for real workloads with thousands of files and repeated scattered mutations; no claim that those workloads have already been measured or qualified follows.
